title: MakeReign Marketplace Section
description: Manifest for a reusable section in the MakeReign marketplace. Every section folder ships one of these. Slimmed in promotion-system-v2 (2026-05-19): curation object + responsive + 4 prose sections were removed in favour of description + tags + preview.png + preview.webm. The slim shape is the load-bearing set for AI section selection (vision model reads the preview directly).

id.description: Stable, globally unique slug. Lowercase hyphenated. e.g. 'hero-split-bold'.

name.description: Human display name. e.g. 'Hero — Split Bold'.

category.description: Marketplace category. Conventional values: hero, intro, carousel, testimonials, gallery, features, forms, cta, footer, navigation, editorial, work, services, contact, process, stats, team.

track.description: Optional release track. Defaults to 'stable'. Quality band — orthogonal to lifecycle.

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle position. Three real states (promotion-system-v2, 2026-05-19): Submitted (waiting on a curator), Approved (live in the catalogue), Archived (removed). Legacy values (Local/Draft/InReview/Promoted/Deprecated) stay in the enum so older section.json files still validate; `getLifecycle()` folds them to the 3 real states. `mr submit` sets this to 'Submitted'. Missing → 'Approved' (legacy default).

attribution.description: Authorship + provenance trail. Populated by `mr submit` at submission time; `promotedAt` set by curator on promotion.

originalCreator.description: Handle of the designer who first built this section.

originatingProject.description: Slug of the project where the section was first built.

approvedAt.description: ISO date when the curator first approved the section into the catalogue.

promotedAt.description: Legacy alias for `approvedAt` (pre-promotion-v2). Kept for backwards compat with older section.json files.

description.description: One-paragraph summary. 1–2 sentences, brand-agnostic, structural. What the section IS, what slots it exposes. Read by both humans and future AI consumers.

props.description: JSON Schema fragment describing the component's props. Freeform; validated only as 'is an object'.

dependencies.description: Required packages (e.g. 'gsap', 'lenis') the section relies on.

motionDensity.description: Optional motion-density tiers — how much motion shows in the layout. Five tiers ordered low to high: static (nothing animates) · low · medium · high · experience (showpiece). Mirrors GLOSSARY.md.

static.description: URL (preferred — Supabase Storage public URL) or relative path to the static preview image. PNG/JPG/WebP/SVG. Relative paths are legacy and migrated to URLs by strip-legacy-curation.ts.

video.description: Optional URL to a short video clip showcasing motion. Supabase Storage public URL. WebM or MP4. Designer/curator uploads via drop-zone in the marketplace detail page.

live.description: Whether the section supports live iframe preview against a project's design system.

tags.description: Discovery tags. 3–6 short kebab-case keywords. AI consumers match these against project briefs. Examples: 'hero', 'split-2col', 'image-right', 'headline-led', 'minimal'.

created.description: ISO date when the section was first submitted.

updated.description: ISO date of the most recent change.

context.description: Optional brand-context reference. 'acme-2025' floats to latest; 'acme-2025@1.0.0' pins. null/omitted/'_neutral' → neutral default. See decision-section-brand-contexts.md.
